title: AuraPromptSchema
description: Schema definition for structured prompt payloads, tool dispatches, and multi-agent coordination within the Lmlm and Aura Ecosystem frameworks.

context_id.description: Unique session token or execution thread identifier.

sender.description: Identifier of the originating agent, user, or system module.

target_module.description: The target subsystem designated to handle the prompt payload.

telemetry_extensions.description: Optional research logging parameters corresponding to .xlsl, .xlog, or .xsim configurations.
